import ast,hashlib,json
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
sim=Path.cwd().resolve()
root=(sim/"test-results/pr33824_expanded_all13_predictors_20260928_1933").resolve()
directory=root/"verification/report_profile_wording_20260929_1159"
before=(directory/"source_before.py").read_bytes()
after=(directory/"source_after.py").read_bytes()
current=(sim/"tools/append_pr33824_expanded_report.py").read_bytes()
changes=json.loads((directory/"prose_changes.json").read_text())["changes"]
digest=lambda data:hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
assert digest(before)=="6c51369a881308bd643d6a960f8c45d70c9d6a34f3a06eebffb48cc126797b76"
assert after==current
restored=after.decode()
for old,new in changes:
    assert restored.count(new)==1
    restored=restored.replace(new,old)
assert restored.encode()==before
def functions(data):
    return {node.name:ast.dump(node,include_attributes=False) for node in ast.parse(data).body if isinstance(node,ast.FunctionDef)}
old_functions,new_functions=functions(before),functions(after)
assert set(old_functions)==set(new_functions)
changed=[name for name in old_functions if old_functions[name]!=new_functions[name]]
assert changed==["main"]
tests_path=sim/"test/test_append_expanded_report.py"
tests=tests_path.read_text()
added=['    assert "3B、7B、32B 抽样 profile" in markdown.read_text()',
'    assert "不是元数据准备、编译等开销的逐项受控对照" in markdown.read_text()',
'    assert "不单独测量缓存命中率" in markdown.read_text()',
'    assert "算子族统计不等于隔离 QK norm 的单项计时" in markdown.read_text()',
'    assert "尚无同配置逐项 profile" not in markdown.read_text()',
'    assert "没有当前逐项 profile 证据" not in markdown.read_text()']
old_tests=tests
for line in added:
    assert old_tests.count(line)==1
    old_tests=old_tests.replace(line+"\n","")
assert digest(old_tests.encode())=="293d109e75e17257d822153e3c6c56f850f494a308e7acee25509f3d854d701e"
compile(current,str(sim/"tools/append_pr33824_expanded_report.py"),"exec")
compile(tests,str(tests_path),"exec")
bundle=root/"models/Qwen3-14B/calibration/training/Qwen3-14B_hgbmono_p50.pkl"
assert digest(bundle.read_bytes())=="79524eef95bf8adeb4d0ea8cd7b185130fedcd0f76716f6b128f7dfba1dc5956"
print(json.dumps({"at":datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),"report_source_before_sha256":digest(before),"report_source_after_sha256":digest(after),"test_source_after_sha256":digest(tests_path.read_bytes()),"exact_prose_reversal_matches_before":True,"changed_functions":["main"],"all_non_main_functions_unchanged":True,"report_literal_changes":3,"test_assertions_added":6,"frozen_qwen3_14b_bundle_unchanged":True,"scope":"Report prose/render regression only; native/training/predictor/scoring/workflow/settings unchanged; no actual profile, final report or full-suite completion claim."}))
